shifted.method: Use exactly wp.next(3.0) on original recorded road/lane, require one result and unchanged road/lane/section. Preserve source lateral offset via waypoint translation, yaw changes only by road tangent delta. Vehicle retains native +0.5m spawn-above-map offset. Walker new ground-source point retains navigation height residual. No fallback or other distance.

walker_spawn: Ground from all15approved sidewalk rays + measured local bounding-box bottom offset + frozen0.03m clearance. No random nav, no actor-center misuse. Verify actual local bbox matches frozen dimensions before qualifying.
physics: Never disable or modify physics. Native vehicles fall naturally; stationary walker zero control only. No planner, autopilot or driving.
actual_geometry: Original M8F actual_check unchanged. Re-anchor only request pose to recorded settled observation to separate allowed natural vertical settling from static-request transport; independently enforce original0.02m XY and0.5degree drift. Full original result against hypothetical request is also retained, never hidden.
support_thresholds: Unchanged configs/m8f/contract.json, including below-OBB ray origin and complete15pointsupport; unknown means reject
failure: Stop failed template, continue other frozen template only. No retry, extra candidate, threshold or source replacement.
preflight_before_RGB: Ego/vehicle/walker Present stability+geometry and fixed Shifted geometry all required; Shifted actual stability+geometry independently re-evaluated at phase
phase_mechanics: Preflight Present targets may be moved to a fixed remote holding location only after passing stability+geometry. Preserve same Actor IDs, restore frozen Present pose and settle again before Present keyframe; Shifted uses fixed pose and natural settling; Removed destroys targets and verifies pixel absence. No held actor qualifies for natural placement.
